trace.bounds: Existing 512 events/node and 1 MiB/node serialized ceiling, 8192-byte exception messages, 32 traceback frames, cause/context depth3, broker stack16. Limits/contention/observer errors mark capture incomplete. Do not loosen these limits or invent truncated content.
trace.observer: Original trace callback only; preserve sys/thread trace finally, profile untouched. Startup sample is non-atomic and only existing startup_error/Event readiness/thread identity/limited current frames; no clock calls or initialization retry. Never translate trace observations into authority.

prerequisite.contract: Exactly unchanged pytest_configure import-only action once. No factory/_identity/open/read call, no reload/prewarm/retry. Verify actual module file/source pin, sys.modules identity and all four pre/post trace/profile states. pytest_configure precedes trace installation in runtest_protocol. Retain raw module/duration evidence without treating it as a clock or cause proof.

reused_plugins.generations: Original plugin schema names and round labels remain unchanged; new invocation explicitly records reuse and both physical pins. Do not rewrite raw plugin output into an R236 schema.
